title: 7 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Cirrhosis
intro: Herbal essential oils for Cirrhosis are natural extracts derived from plants that have been used to alleviate symptoms and promote healing in individuals suffering from liver damage and scarring. These oils are rich in antioxidants and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to reduce liver inflammation, improve liver function, and promote overall liver health. Examples of herbal essential oils for cirrhosis include peppermint oil, which helps to improve digestion and reduce liver inflammation, turmeric oil, which contains curcumin that has anti-inflammatory properties, and rosemary oil, which improves liver function and reduces oxidative stress. Other examples include ginger oil, which reduces inflammation and improves liver function, frankincense oil, which has anti-inflammatory and anti-bacterial properties, and thyme oil, which has antioxidant properties that help to protect the liver from damage.

preparations.preparation_study: According to the study in Phytotherapy research : PTR, Silybum marianum (also known as silymarin) showed beneficial effects on cirrhosis, particularly in reducing liver enzymes such as aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) in three out of six studies.
